all_expectations.description: Pool across every signed expectation at the given horizon.

price_momentum.description: Predict direction = sign of trailing N-day relative-to-QQQ return; score the same way as system predictions. Tests whether the narrative-driven system beats dumb momentum.

sign_flip_rule.evidence_summary: Compound test 2026-05-21: contrarian (sign-flipped) hit_5d 73-81% on inverted public regions across all persistence levels (n=115). Persistence does NOT compound with sign-flip; ship the two rules independently.

velocity.rule: turbulent: >=3 significant lifecycle events in last 14 days (strengthened/weakened/contradicted/reconfirmed/inverted). ossified: no significant events in last 30 days AND region >= 14 days old. working: everything else.
